notes.title: Upcoming updates for my games – overview post
notes.content:
Hello,

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35149563/1f27b730eff5ca3cba12ab760456f0ba03945bef.jpg[/img]

I wanted to share some info about current and upcoming updates. This is a summary post – just find the game you’re interested in. I’m working on all of these titles solo, without a publisher or PR support, so communication isn’t perfect and updates can take time (I also have a full-time job, and game development is still a hobby for now). Always check the demo before buying. Right now, the only game without a demo is Moving Letters (it’s not finished yet). If a game doesn’t work or has issues, don’t hesitate to use Steam’s refund option. If there is no information about the game, it means it is not released and is still being worked on.

[h1]Game-by-game update list:[/h1]
[u][b]HorrorCore[/b][/u]
Minor fixes. A sequel is planned where you play a detective investigating a mysterious painting.

[u][b]Airhack[/b][/u]
???

[u][b]Rap Simulator[/b][/u]
More info: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1099510/view/536604072953776663

[u][b]The Liminal Dimension[/b][/u]
Performance improvements. Continuation is planned (hinted at in the post-credits scene).

[u][b]Whispering Lane[/b][/u]
Fixes to the Last Hope mode. Continuation also planned (post-credits intro).

[u][b]Another Hardest Game[/b][/u]
Minor bug fixes.

[u][b]Apartament 1406[/b][/u]
Bug fixes, Improvements to Last Hope mode. The story is planned to continue in a two-part structure.

[u][b]Resoraki[/b][/u]
Fixes, a new night track, and some community suggestions added.
Multiplayer is under consideration – either as an update or as Resoraki 2.

[u][b]OutWave[/b][/u]
Minor fixes and implementation of player feedback.

[u][b]CATAIRE[/b][/u]
No CATAIRE 2 planned, but a big update is coming: UNDO and RESET buttons, HD visuals, and online scoreboards.

[b][u]A Last Will and Testament[/u][/b]
Minor fixes. Possible continuation.

[u][b]Hovercars 3077[/b][/u]
New tracks, cars, online rankings, and UI improvements (incl. ultrawide 21:9 support).

[u][b]MUMBA IV[/b][/u]
Already received a recent update. Possible continuation (next adventure trip).

[u][b]Shop Tycoon: Prepare Your wallet[/b][/u]
I'm currently working on Shop Tycoon 2: Revenge of the Bandytko Gang.
Once that’s finished, I might port Shop Tycoon 1 to the new engine with HD visuals (I’ll ask for community feedback first).

[u][b]ASMR LIGHTness[/b][/u]
Minor fixes and HD update.

[u][b]Bro, Where Is My Head???[/b][/u]
Minor fixes, maybe online rankings.
Also in the works: a long-awaited sequel – Bro, That’s Not My Head!

[b][u]Moving Letters[/u][/b]
Already updated (server issues fixed). Demo will be added later. Possible HD updated or continuation.

[u][b]THE IMPOSSIBLE[/b][/u]
Free DLC is planned, maybe a HD update and a sequel: THE IMPOSSIBLE 2: New Pat(c)h

[b][u]Play With Me[/u][/b]
I’m moving PWM 1 (Remake) to the engine for PWM 2. After that, Play With Me 2 will be released – and possibly future entries (Play With M3, Play With Me 4, etc.).

notes.title: Shop Tycoon 2, new update, 6000 units solds, small gift
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39124263/5cb18f3570825bb6d35ee7a83817f0d4263f32bb.gif[/img]

Hello!

I hope the Bandytko gang wasn't too frustrating.... They want revenge. But... First of all, Shop Tycoon has already reached around 6,000 players (Ranking: 1. USA, 2. Germany, 3. Japan :O, 4. United Kingdom.... 54. Argentina :O) ! Unfortunately, I haven't been active on Steam too much, a lot of work... Let's hope 2023 will be better? Thanks everyone for buying Shop Tycoon and video gameplay, reviews etc., take some free keys I found on disk (you need to delete the first and last characters): 

[spoiler]XJD5CF-N6ZQ2-RY2FJB
CFP7KN-Q4IIK-ZJ65HB
ZFV3A5-37ATF-BI3MZX[/spoiler]

[h1]Shop Tycoon 2: Bandytko Revenge[/h1]
You ask me if there will be Shop Tycoon 2 and... Yes! But not this year [spoiler] I think 2023 [/spoiler]. Shop Tycoon 2 will be a fusion of some genres of RTS + City builder + Tower defense + Shop Tycoon and is being built on a new engine.

[h1]New version 1.9.20[/h1]
I don't know if there will be an big update this year that I started a few months ago, but I haven't been able to update the game. This update will add a few things and a story mode that will continue in Shop Tycoon 2. Later I will review the forum bugs/suggestions and reviews (because now I don't have much time).

- Vietnamese language bug fixed

notes.content:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39124263/5cb18f3570825bb6d35ee7a83817f0d4263f32bb.gif[/img]

This is the last update for Shop Tycoon in 2021... Unfortunately, it's true that 2022 is coming, but in 2022 will be will be BIG UPDATE :D! In new update I added Credits to the game and put people who helped me. Please check if everything is OK... I forgot someone, but I can't find them on the forum (maybe the post has been deleted), if you are reading this and you are not in credits but you helped with Shop Tycoon, please let me know.

The game has sold almost 4,000 units (TOP COUNTRY: 1. USA, 2. German, 3. Japan, 4. United Kingdom). The game will be, also on Steam Winter sale soon... Thank You!

notes.title: The new version (v1.3.8) is available on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39124263/31ab05224d39c4cde7ad9ba191f33417e4d54e62.gif[/img]

Hello,

There is a new update v1.3.8. The update will be split into two, because I have to wait for some things (e.g. translations).

CHANGES:
- Improved performance on slower computers 5-15 more fps 
- The legendary PAUSE button has been added (beta v5.0)
- Added touch support (if you have a touch screen, e.g. Surface book, you can play in tablet mode)
- Reduced the size of the game by 25% (you download the game/updates faster)
- Extra options added (there will be new options in the next update, waiting for translations for 30 languages)
- Loader speed up by 20-40% (for low-end & pocket potato PC)
- Added 11 new songs and improved music playback
- Font fix (Mac, Linux, Windows)
- Version information added (main menu -> bottom right corner)
- Fixes for inflation
- Update for Windows 32 & 64 bit, Mac 64bit, Linux 32 & 64 bit.
- Small localization fixes (all languages)
- Some small fix for MAC reported by 2 users
- Other minor fixes (Winter sale, extras etc.)

The next update will include (probably next week):
- More customization
- New employees
- Improve tutorial
- Improve gamepad
- New animations for Vodka Store, Sex Shop and Game store etc.
- New options (auto pause in store menu etc.), optimization options, graphics etc.
- Better game code optimization
- Bug fixes reported by players
- And a few more things..............................

Changelog: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1392340/discussions/0/3034851135410861151/

Thanks for your support, feedback and reviews. If there are any problems with the new update please let me know: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1392340/discussions/0/2980781849383914326/.
